name: House Dimir
description: House Dimir is the blue-black Ravnican guild of spies and secrets, devoted to secrecy, manipulation and information brokering.

description_citations.text: "House Dimir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

summary.text: House Dimir is the blue-black Ravnican guild of spies and secrets, devoted to secrecy, manipulation and information brokering.

citations.text: "House Dimir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: The vampire Szadek founded House Dimir and signed the Guildpact as one of the ten paruns.

citations.text: "House Dimir", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"House Dimir", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Agrus Kos arrested Szadek, which broke the Guildpact's spell and exposed him and the guild to the public.

citations.text: "House Dimir", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Dissension", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: After Szadek's death Lazav gathered what remained of the Dimir and had a new Duskmantle built, and Lazav claims to have used Szadek's spirit to reestablish the house.

citations.text: "Lazav", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Szadek", section "Death and reappearance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: In the Return to Ravnica era its agents worked unseen across the city, and rival guilds such as the Boros and Orzhov moved to root out its sleeper cells.

citations.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "The Secretist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Boros Legion", section "The new Hierarchy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Battle for the Ninth". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

bio.text: Before the War of the Spark, Lazav cleansed the guild of Bolas's agents and pledged the Dimir to the alliance opposing Bolas.

citations.text: "Lazav", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"House Dimir", section "Guilds of Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: During the Phyrexian invasion the Dimir staged the elimination of their entire leadership, and Lazav lay low while the guild spread the lie that he had died.

citations.text: "House Dimir", section "Phyrexian Invasion and aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Lazav", section "Phyrexian invasion and aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Mirko Vosk believed the guild was destroyed in the invasion but later became convinced it had faked its demise.

"Mirko Vosk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

status.text: House Dimir is believed by many to be wiped out but is evidently still operating in secret, with Lazav likely running it from the shadows, including on Thunder Junction.

timeline.summary: Szadek is confident that House Dimir's truth will remain hidden.
timeline.quote: even the most perceptive would still be fundamentally unprepared for the truth of House Dimir.

citation.text: Glimpse the Unthinkable (Ravnica: City of Guilds, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos arrested Szadek for crimes against the Guildpact, exploiting a loophole that broke the Guildpact's spell.
timeline.quote: The Guildpact's spell was finally broken when Agrus Kos arrested Szadek for crimes against the Guildpact

citation.text: "Guildpact (spell)", section "The original Guildpact". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The vampire Szadek founds House Dimir and signs the Guildpact as one of the ten paruns.
timeline.quote: House Dimir was founded by the ancient vampire Szadek

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Agrus Kos arrests Szadek, breaking the Guildpact's spell and exposing Szadek and House Dimir to the public.
timeline.quote: The Guildpact's spell was finally broken when Agrus Kos arrested Szadek, which exposed him and House Dimir to the public.

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A new Guildpact does not recognize House Dimir, but the district of Agyrem reappears under the spirit Szadek's control.
timeline.quote: the district of Agyrem reappeared within Ravnica

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kos publicly arrests Szadek, finally breaking the Guildpact's spell and exposing House Dimir.
timeline.quote: The Guildpact's spell is finally broken when he publicly arrests Szadek , exposing him and House Dimir to the public.

citation.text: "Dissension", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Szadek's death, Lazav gathers what remains of the Dimir and has a new Duskmantle built.
timeline.quote: Lazav managed to gather what was left of the Dimir and bring them together.

citation.text: "Lazav", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav cleanses his guild of Bolas's agents and pledges the Dimir to the alliance opposing Bolas at the guild summit.
timeline.quote: he pledged his guild to the alliance that planned to oppose Bolas

citation.text: "Lazav", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dimir agents watched an armory guard for eight hours and Nefara suggested another way in.
timeline.quote: Eight hours, and I've yet to see him blink,

citation.text: Armory Guard (Return to Ravnica, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Trostani commands Emmara to investigate the Izzet and gives her command of the conclave's elementals; she forgives Jace, but House Dimir has followed her.
timeline.quote: House Dimir had already followed Emmara, and she had led them right to Jace.

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "The Secretist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emmara goes willingly with the Rakdos, escapes to the Golgari sewers, and saves Jace from Varolz, but the Dimir strike.
timeline.quote: Using her power over elementals, she saved her friend

citation.text: "Emmara Tandris", section "The Secretist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gorev warns Pel to watch the Dimir and study off-the-books magic.
timeline.quote: That's where the deeper layers of the Dimir are—off the books.

citation.text: "The Absolution of the Guildpact". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Pel resolves to get reassigned to strike at the Dimir in the Undercity.
timeline.quote: He knew he had to get reassigned from topside duty

citation.text: "The Absolution of the Guildpact". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Aurelia shows Gideon the contested Ninth on her war table and explains how the guilds fight over it.
timeline.quote: The Rakdos and Gruul tug and tear it apart like a dromad's corpse

citation.text: "The Greater Good". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Andra writes a coded report: the item is now with a third party, revealing she works for House Dimir and sold the dagger twice.
timeline.quote: All she knew was that the House Dimir wanted it sold to someone in particular, and they didn’t want any link between its new owners and her.

citation.text: "The Hard Sell". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Barrin, convinced the stranger is a Dimir, resolves to follow him despite Nila's objections.
timeline.quote: "He's a Dimir, Nila. I just know it."

citation.text: "Barrin's Tall Tale". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Apr 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Jace reveals he is not a Dimir and warns that the guilds will destroy one another unless he runs the maze in the right sequence.
timeline.quote: The other guilds are going to destroy one another unless I can run the maze in the right sequence.

citation.text: "Barrin's Tall Tale". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Apr 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Oana recognizes Tarem as Dimir and angrily refuses, vowing to destroy the Dimir.
timeline.quote: I will continue his work, and I will earn the right to destroy you.

citation.text: "Expectations". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Jek and Vinni hide in the walls of an apartment in the Ninth District, hunted by Rakdos thrill-killers over a Dimir key.
timeline.quote: Now, he and his sister, Vinni, crouched within the walls of the small apartment

citation.text: "The One Hundred Steps". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 21 May 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Tajic scouts with a platoon, linking with Orzhov patrols that, through Teysa Karlov, helped root out Dimir sleeper cells; the Obzedat agree to shared protection of the Ninth.
timeline.quote: the Boros and Orzhov would share protection duties over the Ninth

citation.text: "Battle for the Ninth". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jun 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Dimir agents watch from the shadows and Nefara suggests another way in.
timeline.quote: I suggest we find another way in.

citation.text: Armory Guard (Duel Decks: Heroes vs. Monsters, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mirko Vosk hunted anyone with knowledge of the maze.
timeline.quote: Mirko Vosk hunted anyone with knowledge of the maze

citation.text: Pilfered Plans (Modern Masters 2017, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lazav tells that some guilds may have fallen under an invader's influence.
timeline.quote: We have intel that some guilds have fallen under an invader's influence.

citation.text: Sinister Sabotage (Guilds of Ravnica, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Aurelia splits the legion into four theatres to deal with threats to public order.
timeline.quote: Aurelia has split leadership of the bulk of the legion into four

citation.text: "Boros Legion", section "The new Hierarchy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav finds and kills the infiltrators in his guild and pledges the Dimir to the alliance opposing Bolas.
timeline.quote: he pledged his guild to the alliance that planned to oppose Bolas

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "Guilds of Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tamsyn is revealed as a Dimir shapeshifter who manipulated Leighbet; Leighbet kills her in the sewers.
timeline.quote: confront and ultimately kill Tamsyn in a battle within the sewer environment

citation.text: "Leighbet", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Merret, working the docks as a Dimir agent, nearly pockets a bottle of expensive whiskey from a crate before his boss approaches and he hides it.
timeline.quote: Sloppy, Merret, sloppy.

citation.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Wothis shoves the investor into the river and jumps in as the crate smashes; Merret fears House Dimir will erase him.
timeline.quote: Nope, there's nothing covert about ruining a thousand zinos worth of cargo.

citation.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Lazav offers to pay Merret's debts, give a stipend, and send a tutor to teach the gifted baby, who stays with the family.
timeline.quote: we would like to ask that we send a tutor to your home to oversee his learning

citation.text: "Under the Cover of Fog" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Tamsyn finds Leighbet in the sewers and reveals she is a shapeshifting Dimir spy who never was a blastseeker.
timeline.quote: There was no chemister, Leighbet. I never was a blastseeker.

citation.text: "Testing the Dark Waters" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Oct 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon and the Dimir exchange words about slipping agents inside Bolas's citadel.
timeline.quote: "Could your agents slip inside Bolas's citadel?"

citation.text: Duskmantle Operative (War of the Spark, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lazav recruits Rat into the Dimir and brainwashes her into a secret assassin.
timeline.quote: Lazav periodically approached Rat in various forms as he slowly brainwashed the young girl

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "Atkos Tarr". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian invasion the Dimir stage the elimination of their entire leadership with eyewitnesses and evidence to fade from public notice.
timeline.quote: they staged the elimination of their entire leadership, complete with eyewitnesses and overwhelming physical evidence

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "Phyrexian Invasion and aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Since the New Phyrexian Invasion, Lazav lies low while the guild spreads the lie that he died, secretly assuming the faces of low-rank agents.
timeline.quote: Many Dimir guild members have spread the lie that he died during the invasion.

citation.text: "Lazav", section "Phyrexian invasion and aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Etrata reveals Teysa secretly spied on the Phyrexians for the resistance, working with House Dimir.
timeline.quote: She was working with House Dimir the whole time

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 9: Beauty in Destruction" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Lazav appears on Thunder Junction, likely to lay low and run the Dimir from the shadows.
timeline.quote: Lazav later appeared on Thunder Junction

citation.text: "Lazav", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Andra sets up a stall in Bane Alley to broker a polished dagger that House Dimir wants sold.
timeline.quote: All she knew was that House Dimir wanted it sold to someone in particular

citation.text: "Andra", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Andra is revealed to have staged the mugging and to be a Dimir agent.
timeline.quote: Andra herself had staged the mugging, and that she was a Dimir agent

citation.text: "Bartek", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bori's cyclone damaged the Dome of the Black Dove and a mass mind attack revealed Dimir conduits.
timeline.quote: He set off a cyclone that damaged the Dome of the Black Dove

citation.text: "Bori Andon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bori exploded the Dimir conduits and the dome crumbled; a vampire enforcer caught him but he escaped, and the Dimir decided to use his skills.
timeline.quote: the Dimir reassessed Bori's capabilities and decided to turn his skills to their cause instead of killing him outright

citation.text: "Bori Andon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bori received a standing ovation and a tiny silver bell that would let the Dimir manipulate his mind.
timeline.quote: he received a standing ovation for having solved the Theorem

citation.text: "Bori Andon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The guilds fight internally over whether to follow Bolas's influence; in the end five fall under his influence and five do not.
timeline.quote: In the end, five fall under his influence, and five don't.

citation.text: "Guilds of Ravnica block", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jek and Vinni obtain a Dimir key and the Dimir organize Rakdos to hunt them.
timeline.quote: The Dimir wanted the key back and organized a band of Rakdos led by an albino man

citation.text: "Jek", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liric travels to Ismeri and enters a Dimir operations house in a guildcloak.
timeline.quote: He walked into a Dimir operations house

citation.text: "Liric", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liric leaves, destroys his strand, and resolves to return to teach, a Dimir agent no more.
timeline.quote: a Dimir agent no more

citation.text: "Liric", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: House Dimir is destroyed in the New Phyrexian Invasion, leaving Mirko adrift.
timeline.quote: Vosk has been adrift ever since House Dimir's destruction

citation.text: "Mirko Vosk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mirko becomes convinced Dimir faked its demise and hunts for Lazav to earn his way back in.
timeline.quote: He's become convinced that House Dimir was not truly destroyed during the invasion

citation.text: "Mirko Vosk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Golgari attack the Boros Legion's headquarters, starting a war; Dimir Lupul worms attack.
timeline.quote: The Golgari attack the Boros Legion ’s headquarters, and it's war.

citation.text: "Ravnica (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav claims to have contacted Szadek's spirit and used it to reestablish House Dimir.
timeline.quote: Lazav , the new guildmaster of House Dimir, claims to have contacted Szadek's spirit

citation.text: "Szadek", section "Death and reappearance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tarem asks Oana to falsify a judgment to free a Dimir agent; she refuses, breaking the deal, and flees.
timeline.quote: Oana refused Tarem however, breaking their deal, and fled.

citation.text: "Tarem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav abducts Varryvort and impersonates him to infiltrate the Izzet and eavesdrop on the guild leaders' summit.
timeline.quote: Lazav assumed Varryvort’s form to gain access to the Izzet’s inner circle

citation.text: "Varryvort", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
